When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The systemic cost of this performative inquiry is the erosion of institutional trust.

The Unavoidable Truth: The claims of mass non-citizen voting have been repeatedly debunked by experts.

The Unavoidable Lie: These classified briefings are necessary for legislative reform.
